title: Bangladesh wage protests: Clashes erupt between garment workers and police, dozens of factories shut
summary_full: Tensions soared in Ashulia as garment workers rallied for higher wages, leading to confrontations with law enforcement. To maintain control, the police deployed tear gas to break up the protest after production was halted. Reports revealed that more than 50 factories chose to close temporarily amid the unrest, with indefinite shutdowns and sit-ins occurring in various industrial areas. This turmoil highlights the ongoing struggle for improved pay and working conditions.
